title: Slice 3: record imports and implements/extends edges
description: DEC-216 (opum-doc, 2026-10-20), Q3: the phased edge widening for v1. After impact lands, the index adds import edges and implements/extends edges beside call and new sites, and impact follows them, so a type, constant or export used without a call is visible. Read/write reference edges remain out of scope. The query semantics for the added edges are not yet named by a design record; settle that with opum-doc before building. Requested by opum-agent for ODOC-487.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The index records import edges and implements/extends edges beside the call and new sites, with each edge kind distinguishable in the machine contract.
The impact traversal follows the added edge kinds, and an edge it cannot resolve is reported in `unresolvedSites` rather than silently dropped.
Tests cover a re-export or alias import chain, an implements edge, an extends edge and an unresolved import, and existing call and new answers are unchanged.
`bun run check` passes; README and the slice-2 ADR or a new decision record name the added edges and their precision caveat.

implementationNotes: Landed via opum-ai/glyph-cli#73, squash f1a0a0c61fc7d7e6b805cf3e5d609e67b94e16aa, built to opum-doc DEC-216 (a3) and (a5) with ADR 0004. Opus reviewer unit glyph-cli-review-73: REQUEST CHANGES at db3611c (one blocking divergence from (a5) item 4, an unindexed export= target written as a module edge), then APPROVED at 244a0b045745958801911e0a35c6173a59afc8d4 after the confirmatory round. Check, Docs and Tracker integrity green on the PR head and on the dev push run. SIZE OVERAGE: the PR is +971/-78 per its last head (+1057/-78 in the squash, 14 files), well over the roughly 400-line ceiling. The leader accepted it whole because tests (test/edges.test.ts) and ADR 0004 carry much of it and a post-hoc split costs more than it saves. Open design points left to opum-doc: a namespace importer of a barrel is not a terminal of the original symbol, and whether 'import {} from' is a module edge; both named in ADR 0004. Follow-ups: GCLI-35.
